$AG_MCM_System_bShowLabels_Help: One switch for every rank label: an adventurer's guild rank after their name, e.g. "Lydia (C)"; the threat rank on an enemy's health bar, e.g. "[C]"; and your own rank beside your level in the menus. Other people's ranks need the Guild's Appraisal skill (Services at a counter). Default: on.
$AG_MCM_System_bShowNotices_Help: The parchment notice for registration, promotion, promotion ready, a completed missive, and entering or clearing a dungeon. Default: on.
$AG_MCM_Audio_bGreetings_Help: What people say to you unasked about the Guild and your rank: guards, townsfolk, adventurers on the road, named members, and merchants who notice a hold's stamp on your card. Off: none of it is said. A stamp still earns its better prices. Default: on.
$AG_MCM_Audio_bInteractions_Help: The Guild questions you can put to people who are not a Guild representative, and Show Guild Card (the card shown in place of a persuasion at a gate, the College, the Treasury House, an Orc stronghold, or to a robber). Off: those choices are gone and the game's own remain. Default: on.
$AG_MCM_Audio_bRepLines_Help: What the innkeepers who keep a Guild counter say in reply to Guild business. Off: each answers with the game's own "Of course." in her own voice and the business is done as before; the choices that only bring an explanation (asking what the Guild is, asking an innkeeper who keeps no counter) are gone. Default: on.
$AG_MCM_System_bNoticeSounds_Help: A sound with the guild notices: promotion, registration, promotion ready, entering a dungeon for the first time, clearing one, a completed missive, notice or bounty, a stamp on your card, Reputation lost. They are the game's own sounds and follow its effects volume. Where another mod has replaced one of those sounds, the notice it belongs to comes without it. Default: on.
$AG_MCM_System_fNoticeSeconds_Help: How many seconds a guild notice stays on screen, plus a brief fade in and out. Default: 5.
$AG_MCM_System_iCardKey_Help: A key that opens your Guild Card anywhere, and closes it again. You must be carrying the card. In VR, pick "Adventurers Guild: Guild Card" as a gesture action in VRIK's own menu instead. Default: none.
$AG_MCM_System_iSLevel_Help: The level at which rank S begins, for you and for the world alike: the level each of your promotions needs, and the rank shown on threats, dungeons and other adventurers. Ranks D and C stay at levels 12 and 24; B and A move with it (shown below). 60 is how every version before 1.4.0 worked. Raise it if your game levels far past 80 or scales enemies up, so that S stays rare. Changing it never changes the rank you hold. A game started before 1.4.0 stays at 60 until you move it. Default: 80.
$AG_MCM_Debug_bDetailedLog_Help: Adds each kill and each Guild counter action to AdventurersGuild.log (Documents/My Games/your Skyrim/SKSE). When reporting a problem: turn this on, reproduce the problem, then send that file before starting the game again. Default: off.
$AG_MCM_Debug_RankReset_Help: Sets your guild rank to the one your current level alone gives (the levels listed on the System page) and your Reputation to the amount that rank starts at. Your current rank and Reputation are replaced; Merit, Appraisal and training are kept. For a character whose record no longer fits: one who joined late, a level overhaul, or testing. Asks before it does anything.
$AG_MCM_Debug_Prepare_Help: Takes back every Guild ability, perk and party bonus from you and your companions, removes Guild items and stops the Guild's quests, so no stat changes stay in your save. Then save, quit and remove the mod.
$AG_MCM_Debug_Cancel_Help: Changed your mind? Restores your Guild abilities, party bonuses and the Guild's quests. Your Guild record was never touched.
